import pandas as pd
import io
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Raw dataset provided as a string
data = """Person ID,Gender,Age,Occupation,Sleep Duration,Quality of Sleep,Physical Activity Level,Stress Level,BMI Category,Blood Pressure,Heart Rate,Daily Steps,Sleep Disorder
1,Male,27,Software Engineer,6.1,6,42,6,Overweight,126/83,77,4200,
2,Male,28,Doctor,6.2,6,60,8,Normal,125/80,75,10000,
3,Male,28,Doctor,6.2,6,60,8,Normal,125/80,75,10000,
4,Male,28,Sales Representative,5.9,4,30,8,Obese,140/90,85,3000,Sleep Apnea
5,Male,28,Sales Representative,5.9,4,30,8,Obese,140/90,85,3000,Sleep Apnea
"""

# Read the data into a pandas DataFrame
df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(data))

# Data Preprocessing: Fill missing Sleep Disorder values with 'None' for better visualization
df['Sleep Disorder'] = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None')

# Set a professional style for the plots
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid")

# Create a figure with two subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(16, 7))
fig.suptitle('Sleep Health Analysis', fontsize=18, y=1.02)

# Plot 1: Scatter plot of Sleep Duration vs. Quality of Sleep,
# colored by Stress Level and sized by Daily Steps
sns.scatterplot(
    data=df,
    x='Sleep Duration',
    y='Quality of Sleep',
    hue='Stress Level',
    size='Daily Steps',
    sizes=(50, 400), # Range of marker sizes
    palette='viridis', # Color palette for stress level
    ax=axes[0],
    alpha=0.8,
    legend='full'
)
axes[0].set_title('Sleep Duration vs. Quality of Sleep by Stress Level & Daily Steps', fontsize=14)
axes[0].set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12)
axes[0].set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=12)
axes[0].set_xticks(sorted(df['Sleep Duration'].unique())) # Ensure all sleep durations are visible
axes[0].set_yticks(sorted(df['Quality of Sleep'].unique())) # Ensure all quality values are visible
axes[0].grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.6)

# Plot 2: Count plot of Sleep Disorder distribution
sns.countplot(
    data=df,
    y='Sleep Disorder',
    order=df['Sleep Disorder'].value_counts().index, # Order by frequency
    palette='pastel', # Color palette for count plot
    ax=axes[1]
)
axes[1].set_title('Distribution of Sleep Disorders', fontsize=14)
axes[1].set_xlabel('Number of Individuals', fontsize=12)
axes[1].set_ylabel('Sleep Disorder', fontsize=12)
axes[1].grid(axis='x', linestyle='--', alpha=0.6) # Only x-axis grid for count plot

# Adjust layout to prevent overlapping titles/labels
